card.text: The secondary star of OGLE-SMC-ECL-1421, a pair that eclipse each other every 102.834 days.

sources.label: Graczyk et al. 2020
sources.locator: DEBCat (Southworth 2015, ASPC 496, 164), OGLE-SMC-ECL-1421: Mass, Radius and Period, from Graczyk et al. (2020ApJ...904...13G)

introduction.text: It has 2.85 solar masses and 23.8 solar radii; its partner has 2.72 and 17.7, measured from the eclipses and the stars' motions.
